# TreeView

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

data · tier 3 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

A file tree, a folder picker, an outline: nodes in levels that open and close. Its open branches flatten into one windowed list, so 10,000 nodes stay fast.

```tsx
import { TreeView } from 'topclassui'
```

```tsx
<TreeView
  aria-label="Files"
  defaultValue="page"
  defaultExpanded={['app']}
  items={[
    { id: 'app', label: 'app', children: [
      { id: 'layout', label: 'layout.tsx' },
      { id: 'page', label: 'page.tsx' },
    ] },
    { id: 'readme', label: 'README.md' },
  ]}
/>
```

- **Data, not a function.** `items` is plain data, so a Server Component passes it as it is. The `id` is the key; there is no `getKey`. An `icon` is an element, such as `<Svg icon={folder} />` (R-7-2).
- **A branch** is a node with `children`, even `[]`. To load a branch's children, listen to `onExpandedChange` and pass them in through `items`.
- **Paging.** `loadMore` asks for the next page of root nodes, once per page, while `hasMore`. The tree never fetches.
- **The real type the table prints as `unknown`:** `virtualize` is `'auto' | boolean`.
- **Where the props go.** `className`, `style`, `ref` and every other prop reach the element with `role="tree"`, not the box around it.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| ArrowDown, ArrowUp | the next or the previous visible row; no wrap |
| ArrowRight (ArrowLeft in Arabic) | opens a closed branch; on an open one, moves to its first child |
| ArrowLeft (ArrowRight in Arabic) | closes an open branch; anything else moves to its parent |
| Home, End | the first, the last visible row |
| Enter, or a press | selects the row, and opens or closes a branch |
| Space | selects the row |
| A letter | the next row whose label starts with what was typed in the last 500 ms |

The tree is the one tab stop and keeps the focus; `aria-activedescendant` names the row the keys are on.

## While it loads

```tsx
<Suspense fallback={<TreeViewSkeleton rows={8} />}>
  <FileTree />
</Suspense>
```

- **Same box, same rows**: the tree's border, padding and row height, 44 px under a finger, and rows indented as a tree, so nothing moves when the tree arrives. Pass the rows the tree will show as `rows`, up to 20; past the `--tc-list-rows` knob the box is cut where the tree would scroll.
- **For the first load only.** While a tree on the page waits for its next page, `status="loading-more"` says so under it.

**Not built:** multi-select and checkboxes, `selectionMode`, `showLines`, the folder and folder-open swap, `*` to open every sibling, drag to reorder, links in rows, an `error` status, `selectedItem`, an `indent` prop (the `--tc-tree-indent` token is the knob), `size`, a loading row inside a branch.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { TreeView } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Required: `items`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Every other prop below is optional.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | **yes** | `readonly TreeNode[]` | - | The nodes, as plain data. Keep the array stable between renders. |
| `aria-label` | **yes**, or `aria-labelledby` | `string` | - | The name read out when no visible text names the group. |
| `aria-labelledby` | **yes**, or `aria-label` | `string` | - | The id of the visible text that names the group. |
| `className` | no | `string` | - | On the element with role tree, merged last. |
| `defaultExpanded` | no | `readonly string[]` | - | The ids open when the tree mounts. |
| `defaultValue` | no | `string \| null` | - | The id selected when the tree mounts. |
| `emptyFallback` | no | `ReactNode` | - | What status empty says, in place of labels.state.empty. |
| `expanded` | no | `readonly string[]` | - | The ids of the open branches. Use with onExpandedChange when controlled. |
| `hasMore` | no | `boolean` | - | More root nodes exist, so loadMore is called when the tree nears its end. |
| `loadingFallback` | no | `ReactNode` | - | What status loading says, in place of labels.common.loading. |
| `loadMore` | no | `(() => void \| Promise<void>)` | - | Called with no argument for the next page of root nodes, once per page. It never fetches a branch. |
| `loadMoreThreshold` | no | `integer`, min 0, max 200 | `10` | How many rows from the end loadMore is called, clamped. |
| `onExpandedChange` | no | `((ids: readonly string[]) => void)` | - | Called with every open id after a branch opens or closes: load a branch's children here. |
| `onValueChange` | no | `((id: string) => void)` | - | Called with the id of the node Enter, Space or a press selects. |
| `status` | no | `idle` \| `loading` \| `loading-more` \| `empty` | `"idle"` | loading and loading-more mark the tree busy and say so under it; empty says there is nothing. |
| `value` | no | `string \| null` | - | The selected node's id, or null for none. Use with onValueChange when controlled. |
| `virtualize` | no | `unknown` | `"auto"` | auto windows the tree above 200 visible rows; true always, false never. |
| `visibleRows` | no | `integer`, min 1, max 20 | `7` | Rows the tree shows before it scrolls, clamped. Left out, the --tc-list-rows knob applies. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
